If L traces sources, each source he sees cuts his pool to 25%. Two sources give 6.25%, and a third would drop it to about 1.6%, below the 2% (200k) catch line. Make every kill a quick entry in the AFTERNOON. Timing then rules out only day workers (keeps students, night workers and home = 55%). Worst case pool is 10M x 0.0625 x 0.55 = about 344k, which is safe. That is 5 kills a day. Day 1: did 5 kills. Watch the press conferences. If an announcement is near or below 300k, still don't add sources. If one shows 1M or more for a long time, still stay safe.
